why: carries Wu's taxonomy vocabulary, which a direction-(i) payload may never contain
unit_portion: The check reported success while the records underneath it were erroring rather than passing — a textbook Class B positional-parse failure, and a fail-plausible one at that. The concealer here was the status file; the amplifier was the retry loop. Compare the gray failure described under meta-rule MR-12 and INV-ONTOLOGY-001, logged in the openclaw repo.
